# Data Source: identitynow_identity_attribute

Use this data source to look up an identity attribute by its technical name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_identity_attribute" "department" {
  name = "department"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Technical name of the identity attribute.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Business-friendly name of the identity attribute.
- `id` (String) Identity attribute ID, the same as `name`.
- `multi` (Boolean) Whether the attribute is multi-valued.
- `searchable` (Boolean) Whether the attribute is searchable.
- `sources_json` (String) Sources of the attribute value as a JSON array.
- `standard` (Boolean) Whether the attribute is a standard attribute.
- `system` (Boolean) Whether the attribute is a system attribute.
- `type` (String) Type of the identity attribute.
